thread:
Nora Elbaz: Heads up — launching a new Customer Reliability team next month to centralize incident response, postmortem ownership, and customer-facing runbook ops. This combines parts of Support-Platform QA and Incident Response leads. Hiring update below.
Tobias Chen: Hi all — excited to join as Sr. Manager for Customer Reliability (start date 3/15). I'll be focusing on paging workflows, postmortem SLAs, and improving runbook coverage. Happy to meet 1:1s next week. :wave:
Evan Carter: Quick note — I9ll act as interim Incident Lead from 3/1 until Tobia9s start. I9ll take the on-call triage handoff and keep the weekly incident sync.
Maya Singh: Welcome Tobias! A few asks: can we preserve current playbooks for the ML infra team? we rely on specific escalation steps for KV cache issues.
Tobias Chen: Absolutely. First 30 days product: audit critical runbooks, meet SRE/Runtime leads, and triage 2 largest recurring incidents. Will prioritize ML infra runbooks.
Nora Elbaz: People Ops/comp note: we approved a relocation stipend and new-hire sign-on for Tobias. Mariam/people-ops-bot to confirm req closure and posting.
people-ops-bot: Req closed: REQ-7801 (sr-manager-customer-reliability). Offer details recorded in HR case 45521.
engineering-manager-bot: Calendar: customer-reliability-intro-90m 9— Tue 9am PT (invite sent). Link: https://cal.redwood.example/event/2345678901
Evan Carter: Ops question: will on-call rotations change? If so, please post a diff. Also I9ll need edit rights to /playbooks/incident-runbooks.
Nora Elbaz: On-call rota stays same for now. We9ll post proposed rota in /docs/oncall-proposals before any change. Evan, granted write to the playbooks repo; you should get an email.
Maya Singh: Adding: ML infra needs a documented escalation for degraded KV cache that includes the exact query to run. I'll open a PR.
Tobias Chen: Thanks Maya — tag me on the PR and I'll prioritize review. Also creating a short form survey for teams to flag missing runbooks.
Nora Elbaz: Hiring timeline: we still need a principal incident responder (S5 IC) and a reliability engineer (S3). People Ops will open two reqs tomorrow. Candidate slate ETA 3 weeks.
people-ops-bot: Reqs opened: REQ-7802 (principal-incident-responder), REQ-7803 (reliability-engineer). Links: https://hr.redwood.example/req/REQ-7802
Tobias Chen: If anyone has referrals, please DM me or use hiring@redwood.com. Looking for folks with postmortem-first mindset and playbook-skill.
Evan Carter: I'll update the incident-channel handbook and schedule a dry-run tabletop exercise for week 2 of March.
Nora Elbaz: Final note for managers: please do not repurpose the two headcount seats until people-ops confirms. We'll run a hiring sync every Thursday 11am PT starting this week.
people-ops-bot: Hiring sync calendar: Thu 11am PT recurring. Invite: https://cal.redwood.example/meet/hsync-780
Tobias Chen: Thanks everyone — excited to get started. I'll drop an intro doc in /docs/team/ when I arrive.
Maya Singh: Welcome again! :tada:
summary: Announcement: creation of Customer Reliability team; Tobias Chen joining as Sr. Manager; Evan Carter interim Incident Lead; opening two reqs for principal responder and reliability engineer; hiring and operational next steps.
